resources.string: Your music, shaped around the way you listen.
Choose Music on this device to scan your songs after granting audio access. You can also connect YouTube Music, Spotify, Navidrome or Jellyfin here.
Open Settings to explore Aurora’s audio tools.
Shape your sound with EQ, device presets, convolution and channel controls.
Use ReplayGain and volume leveling for a more consistent listening level.
Fine-tune processing and explore more ways to customize your playback.
See what happens to your audio from the source to the output device.
Toggle this to disable the advanced features.
For local songs, copy music files onto your device and allow Aurora access. For your own server library, add Navidrome or Jellyfin in Servers & accounts. Manage all sources in Library & sources.
Take another look at Aurora’s features
